normalization.volume_rule: Preserve atomic 9.341 * 16, not substitute rounded 149.46. No measured ambient V0 exists for this nonmagnetic branch.

source_variants.published_Table6_BM3: Same source curve at printed Pr=0; one catalog record, not an additional independent fit.
source_variants.later_Litasov_2013_Vinet: 148.5 A3/cell, 316(6) GPa, 3.5(1) at 298 K; later recalibrated literature comparison. Kept separate and not integrated.

source_selection.shared_observations: Li selected rows are unchanged members of existing cementite_li_2002_table1; no pressure recalibration or new independent measurements.
source_selection.missing_identifiers: Li run and measurement identifiers remain missing, not invented; original T1 row IDs identify the observations.

uncertainty: Parenthesized last-digit errors preserved. Source confidence, cross-row/calibrant covariance, original regression weighting and uncertainty scaling unspecified. Missing errors are not zero.

pressure_basis.sata_rows: Paired B1 MgO, Speziale et al. (2001), source footnote prints 2000; BM3 V0=74.71 A3/cell, K0=160.2 GPa, Kprime=3.99.
pressure_basis.li_rows: Original Li (2002) ruby/neon pressures; not relabelled as MgO or silently recalibrated.
pressure_basis.limits: Printed MgO parameters leave up to 0.353 GPa discrepancy. Exact author reducer and raw Li ruby wavelengths unavailable. Table 2 multi-calibrant consistency experiments are separate from paired Fe3C sample measurements.

structure: Existing Prescher high-pressure Pnma atomic model retained unchanged. Sata axes = (standard c, standard a, standard b); volume and Z invariant. Table 4 heading says 193 GPa, while paragraph 14/Figure 3 say 187 GPa and Table 1 measurement id193 has P=186.60(33) GPa; retain this discrepancy without replacing the pressure.
